title: The working issue
description: A red-cover magazine of shipped products, with large serif type and turning feature spreads.
signature: The feature spread opens like a page; the next control turns to a new project and its real facts.
holdback: The enormous serif Shipped and asymmetric spread produce a coherent composition, while the visible 16 security and tenant-isolation tests supply personal substance. The feature controls reveal different project facts. However, removing the book styling leaves a standard three-item carousel and ordinary index. Mobile retains the two-page split at a scale that weakens the editorial idea.
slopCauses: The displayed surname retains the checklist's trailing full stop.
